thread:
emma: deploy-bot flagged a canary in eu-west for checkout-service. sudden connectionPool increase after chart v1.9.0. quarantine recommended.
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary anomaly: 7/12 pods > 200 DB conns; tcp retries up; suggested quarantine and hold promotion.
josh: quick diff shows values.yaml changed pool.max: 80 -> 320, pool.idleTimeout: 60s -> 10s. looks like bad defaults shipped with chart bump.
emma: change window closes in ~40m. product prefers not to lose image fixes. Options: manual values revert (pin), or rollback images. Thoughts?
release-ops: manual pin needs an emergency change note and a one-line audit blurb. We can file that now if engineering decides.
sre-oncall: risk: DB connection exhaustion and some pods OOM. Hotpatching pool.max back to 80 should mitigate quickly. Also recommend temporarily capping HPA maxReplicas to avoid compounding.
josh: plan: apply helm values revert in canary namespace, cap HPA, monitor for 12m. If errors or latency persist, rollback to image tag v1.8.7.
emma: commands I'll run:
```
helm upgrade checkout-canary ./charts/checkout -n checkout-canary --reuse-values --set pool.max=80,pool.idleTimeout=60
kubectl patch hpa checkout-canary -n checkout-canary -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":4}}'
kubectl rollout status deploy/checkout-canary -n checkout-canary
```
Then monitor DB conns and pod restarts for 12 minutes.
release-ops: filing EMERGENCY-CHANGE-1736 and opening release-note PR. Draft blurb: "Canary: reverted pool values in eu-west after accidental bump in chart v1.9.0; pinned values pending CI change to enforce sane defaults."
sre-oncall: helm upgrade done. pods rolling; one restart with OOM but now 5/6 healthy. DB conns back to baseline within 3m. Muted noisy alerts for 12m.
emma: monitoring ticking. If stable for 12m we promote with a note that values were pinned; follow-up ticket for CI validation created.
josh: opening ticket for CI rule to block pool.max > 200.
release-ops: release-notes PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/PR-4412  tagging compliance.
sre-oncall: unmuting alerts. leaving thread open for final 12m verification.
